modules.title: Introduction to Nigeria in Africa
modules.html:
Nigeria's role in ECOWAS, the African Union and peacekeeping in Africa. This section covers introduction to nigeria in africa.

Key points

  • The Amalgamation of Northern and Southern Nigeria in 1914 was performed by _____. — Lord Frederick Lugard.
  • The first military coup d'état in Nigeria occurred on _____. — January 15, 1966.
  • Which of the following bodies was formed in 1975 to promote economic integration in West Africa — ECOWAS.
  • The leader of the National Congress of British West Africa (NCBWA) was _____. — Casely Hayford.
  • The major reason for the 'Scramble for Africa' by European powers was _____. — economic need for markets and raw materials.

Worked examples

Q: The Amalgamation of Northern and Southern Nigeria in 1914 was performed by _____.
A: Lord Frederick Lugard — Lord Lugard merged the two protectorates into a single entity primarily for administrative convenience and financial reasons.

Q: The first military coup d'état in Nigeria occurred on _____.
A: January 15, 1966 — The January 1966 coup, led by Major Nzeogwu and others, ended the First Republic and resulted in the deaths of several top politicians.

quiz.q: The Amalgamation of Northern and Southern Nigeria in 1914 was performed by _____.
quiz.solution: Lord Lugard merged the two protectorates into a single entity primarily for administrative convenience and financial reasons.

quiz.q: The first military coup d'état in Nigeria occurred on _____.
quiz.solution: The January 1966 coup, led by Major Nzeogwu and others, ended the First Republic and resulted in the deaths of several top politicians.

quiz.q: Which of the following bodies was formed in 1975 to promote economic integration in West Africa?
quiz.solution: The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) was established via the Treaty of Lagos to foster economic cooperation among member nations.

quiz.q: The leader of the National Congress of British West Africa (NCBWA) was _____.
quiz.solution: Casely Hayford of Ghana led the NCBWA, which pushed for reforms and greater participation of educated Africans in colonial government.

quiz.q: The major reason for the 'Scramble for Africa' by European powers was _____.
options: economic need for markets and raw materials
the desire to end tribal wars
quiz.solution: The Industrial Revolution in Europe created a desperate need for secure sources of raw materials and markets for finished goods.

quiz.q: The 'Apartheid' system in South Africa was officially dismantled in _____.
quiz.solution: Following the release of Nelson Mandela and negotiations, the first multi-racial elections were held in 1994.

quiz.q: The 'Mancala' game and the decimal system in West Africa are often cited as evidence of _____.
quiz.solution: Such cultural developments demonstrate that African societies had advanced social and mathematical systems long before outside contact.

quiz.q: The policy of 'Assimilation' was used in Africa by _____.
quiz.solution: France initially sought to turn their African subjects into 'Black Frenchmen' by teaching them French language, culture, and law.

quiz.q: The first indigenous Governor-General and later the first President of Nigeria was _____.
quiz.solution: Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe served as Governor-General in 1960 and became President in 1963.

quiz.q: The 'Warrant Chief' system failed in Southeastern Nigeria because _____.
options: it lacked traditional legitimacy in an acephalous society
quiz.solution: The Igbo had no kings; the British creation of Warrant Chiefs was seen as artificial and oppressive.

quiz.q: The primary aim of the 'Apartheid' system in South Africa was _____.
options: Racial segregation and white minority rule
quiz.solution: Apartheid was a legal system of discrimination maintained by the National Party until 1994.

quiz.q: The 'Great Trek' in South Africa was undertaken by the _____.
quiz.solution: The Boers migrated inland in the 1830s to escape British colonial administration in the Cape.

quiz.q: Nigeria has how many geopolitical zones?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 6.

quiz.q: Nigeria became a federal state under the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Lyttleton Constitution (1954).

quiz.q: Nigeria's first President was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Nnamdi Azikiwe.

quiz.q: Nigeria's currency was changed from Pounds to Naira in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 1973.

quiz.q: Zik of Africa refers to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Nnamdi Azikiwe.

quiz.q: The Islamic Jihad of 1804 in Northern Nigeria was led by...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Uthman Dan Fodio.

quiz.q: The first Governor-General of unified Nigeria was...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Lord Frederick Lugard.

quiz.q: The Lyttleton Constitution of 1954 is famous for establishing a true ___ system in Nigeria.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Federal.

quiz.q: Who was the first indigenous Governor-General and later President of Nigeria?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe.

quiz.q: Which constitution introduced the federal system in Nigeria?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Lyttelton 1954.

quiz.q: Nigeria's current democratic dispensation began in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 1999.

quiz.q: The first TV station in Africa (WNTV) was established in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 1959.

quiz.q: The first TV station in Africa (WNTV) was in:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: 1959.

quiz.q: The legendary founder of the Yoruba race at Ile-Ife was...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Oduduwa.

quiz.q: The Aba Women's Riot of 1929 was triggered by...
options: The census and fear of taxing women
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: The census and fear of taxing women.

quiz.q: The Jihad of 1804 was primarily:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Religious and Social.

quiz.q: The NYSC was established in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 1973.

quiz.q: Which empire collapsed due to Alimi's treachery?
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Oyo Empire.
